name: Unity Software Inc.
blurb: Unity Software Inc. operates a platform for developing, deploying, and growing games and interactive experiences across mobile, PC, console, and extended reality devices. The company provides AI solutions that support the entire development lifecycle, including prototyping, live operations, user acquisition, and monetization. Its Create Solutions suite is widely used by game developers and creators. Unity is a leading player in the real-time 3D development market, competing with Epic Games' Unreal Engine.
recent: As of May 6, 2026, Unity's stock closed at $27.28, down 0.22% on the day, with a market cap of $11.90B. The company has a 52-week range of $16.78 to $52.15 and a forward PE of 26.61. Analysts have a Buy rating with a price target of $36.56, implying 34% upside. Earnings are scheduled for May 7, 2026.
